name: Nomura Research Institute, Ltd.
summary: Nomura Research Institute, Ltd. engages in the provision of consulting, financial information technology (IT) solutions, Industrial IT solutions, and IT Infrastructure services in Japan and internationally. The Consulting segment offers management, organizational reform, and system consulting services for all aspects of IT management. The Financial IT Solutions segment provides systems consulting, systems development and operation services, and shared systems, primarily to financial industry clients in the securities, insurance, and banking industries.
